title: When ego keeps making the self too large in the day as it is
issueStatement: The self keeps pushing itself to the center of the room. The pressure is not abstract anymore; it is meeting the ordinary shape of the day.
centralInsight: Guru names haumai clearly and then redirects the heart toward humility, service, and truth. Gurbani refuses to treat the ordinary day as spiritually irrelevant.
practicalReflection: The cure begins when ego is seen as illness rather than identity. Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it.
actionPrompt: Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it. Keep the response small enough to survive an ordinary day.

source.lifeApplication: The cure begins when ego is seen as illness rather than identity. Let the wider window set the tone before the old reflex does.
